items.title: Email Workflow Optimization
items.description:
This client was struggling with an overcrowded inbox, missed follow-ups, and difficulty identifying priority emails. I stepped in, reorganized and categorized 600+ emails, implemented filters, labels, priority rules, and a follow-up system, and cleared outdated messages.

The outcome? A 95% reduction in inbox clutter, faster identification of priority emails, and a more structured workflow for managing daily communications.

items.title: Project Coordination System
items.description: In need of a clearer system to organize projects, track responsibilities, and stay on top of deadlines. I created 2 project management systems using Notion and Trello. In Notion, I built a task manager tracking priority, assignee, status, and due date, alongside a calendar tracker for deadlines. In Trello, I organized projects across 4 workflow stages: To Do, In Progress, Waiting for Approval, and Completed which improved task visibility, accountability, and workflow tracking.

items.title: Expense Tracking & Report
items.description: The business needed a reliable way to monitor monthly business expenses and identify where the most money was being spent. Using Google Sheets, I tracked and categorized 20 transactions across 8 expense categories, then created a pie chart to visually highlight the highest-spending category. I compiled the analysis into a structured Microsoft Word report, giving the client a clear overview of monthly spending and supporting better expense monitoring and financial decision-making.

items.title: Calendar Management & Scheduling Coordination
items.description:
A structured calendar was created to coordinate meetings, appointments, time-blocked work sessions, and schedules across different time zones. Guest invitations, meeting details, and virtual meeting links were added to keep participants informed and organized.

The outcome? A clearer view of priorities, fewer scheduling conflicts, better protection of focused work time, and smoother meeting coordination.

items.title: Travel Coordination System
items.description:
I developed a centralized travel coordination system to organize flights, hotels, itineraries, and expenses. Researched and compared travel options, organized 20+ data points in Excel, and created a structured travel report for easier decision-making.

Then built a budget tracker to compare projected and actual costs, monitor spending, and ensure the trip stayed within budget. The final system provided a clear overview of travel arrangements and budget status.

items.title: File Organization & Document Management
items.description:
I transformed an unstructured Google Drive into a clear, organized document management system. By creating a logical folder hierarchy, categorizing files, and applying consistent naming conventions, I improved file accessibility and made documents faster to locate and manage.

The result was a cleaner digital workspace, more efficient document retrieval, and a structured workflow that supports smoother day-to-day administrative operations.

items.title: Data Collection & Response Tracking
items.description: In need of a simpler way to collect and keep track of survey responses without manually sorting through submissions. I created a Google Forms survey and linked it to Google Sheets, where responses were automatically organized and tracked. This reduced manual data entry, kept all responses in one place, and made it easier to monitor submissions, review the data, and identify useful patterns for decision-making.
